item.title: Studio Discovery Tour Artist Exhibition & Reception — Wed Aug 26, 4:00 PM — The Sea Ranch Lodge
item.description:
The Studio Discovery Tour, hosted by the North Coast Artists Guild, is entering its 34th year of showcasing Sonoma and Mendocino County-based artists and their studios. This year’s tour takes place on 08.29 – 08.30 and 09.05 – 09.07 (Labor Day weekend). The Tour features 43 individual artists showing at 30 different studios, including 22 studios located on The Sea Ranch. This is an opportunity to meet local fine artists and see their work, as well as get a sneak peek at their Sea Ranch homes and studios.
The Sea Ranch Lodge will host one of three preview shows, from 08.26 – 09.07, with an opening reception and wine event on Wednesday, 08.26 from 4pm -6pm.
Just a little north of the Lodge on The Sea Ranch will be a group of artists that include “tinkerers” and naturalists Mike Petrich and Karen Wilkinson. Mike’s wildlife photography is unparalleled and Karen’s botanical illustrations are incredibly lifelike. Their studio is on Annapolis Road (by The Wine Shop).

Whether you like melodic vocals, searing guitar and sax solos, intriguing lyrics, captivating songs, or just great dynamic and danceable rhythms, The Social Contractors won't disappoint.
The Social Contractors lineup for this free live performance features band founder and songwriter, Jason E Davies (lead vocals, lead/rhythm guitar), Travis Thayer (sax/keys/vocals), Alex Fabian-Davies (bass), and Chris Oatman (drums).

item.title: Rare Films Event "Capt Brightthorn & the Legion of Doom" — Sun Aug 30, 4:30 PM — Isis Oasis Sanctuary
item.description:
The Redwood Theater at Isis Oasis Sanctuary is inviting you to an afternoon premiere showing of two films that you are truly unlikely to see anywhere else. One is the work of independent filmmaker Tom Lux and was filmed at Isis Oasis itself - Commander BrightThorn and the Legion of Doom - Episode IV. (The fate of the other episodes remains mysterious.)
The second film in this double feature is a short documentary tour of Huntington Castle in Clonegal, Ireland - "Calling on Clonegal" paying a visit to bestselling author, mystic and priestess Lady Olivia Robertson, produced and directed by Ann Waters.
Filmmakers will be present for a chat after the screenings, and Egyptian popcorn will be provided. Come join us for a fun and peculiar afternoon in the beautiful Redwood temple theater at Isis Oasis Sanctuary!
Source: North Bay Bohemian
